SIND LOCAL COUNCIL (ELECTION) RULES, 1979
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary, Part IV‑A, 27th August 1979]
No. OSD/Elect/LG/106/79.---‑In exercise of the
powers conferred by section 103 of the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979,
the Government of Sind are pleased to make the following rules :‑-----
CHAPTER I‑PRELIMINARY
1. (1) These rules may be called the Sind Local
Council (Election) Rules, 1979.
(2) They shall come into force
at once.
2. In these rules, unless there is anything repugnant
in the subject or context‑----
(1) "candidate" means a person proposed as
a candidate for or seeking election as s member;
(2) "contesting
candidate" means a validly nominated candidate who has not withdrawn his
candidature;
(3) "Delimitation
Officer" means a person appointed by the Election Authority under sub‑rule
(3) of rule 8;
(4) "election" means
an election to a council;
(5) "election
petition" means a petition made under rule 65;
(6) "elector" means a person who is
enrolled on the electoral roll for an electoral unit;
(7) "electoral roll"
means the electoral roll referred to in section 35;
(8) "electoral unit"
means an electoral unit delimited under these rules;
(9) "Form" means a
form appended to these rules;
(10) "Ordinance" means the Sind Local
Government Ordinance, 1979;
(11) "Polling Officer" means a Polling
Officer appointed under rule 15;
(12) "Polling Programme" means the
programme according to which polling under these rules is to be held;
(13) "Polling
Station" means the premises where arrangements are made for polling;
(14) "Presiding
Officer" means a Presiding Officer appointed under rule 15 for a polling
station and includes an Assistant Presiding Officer ;
(15) "returned
candidate" means a candidate who elected as a member under these rules;
(16) "Returning
Officer" means a Returning Officer rule I1 and includes an Assistant
Returning Officer;
(17) "section" means
section of the Ordinance;
(18) "Tribunal"'
means an Election Tribunal appointed under rule 69 for the trial of election
petitions;
(19) "withdrawal day"
means a day appointed on or before which candidature may be withdrawn.
CHAPTER II‑ELECTION
AUTHORITY
3. Powers and functions of Election Authority.‑The Election
Authority shall exercise powers and perform its functions in accordance with
the Ordinance and rules including the power to review an order passed by any
Officer and make such consequential orders as it may consider appropriate for
ensuring fair election.
4. Organization of elections.‑Subject to the provisions of the
Ordinance, the Election Authority shall organize and conduct an election.
5. Decision by the Election Authority.‑(1)
If upon any matter requiring a decision of the Election Authority, the opinion
of the majority shall prevail and the decision of the Authority shall be
expressed in terms of the opinion of the majority.
(2) The Election Authority may
exercise its powers and perform its functions notwithstanding that there is a
vacancy in the office of any member or that any of its members is, for any
reason, unable to attend any of its proceedings.
6. Delegation of powers.‑The Election Authority may authorize
its Chairman or any of its members to
exercise and perform all or any of its powers and functions under these rules.
7. Assistant to the Election
Authority.‑(1) The Election Authority may require any person or authority to perform such functions
or render such assistance in connection with an election as it may direct.
(2) All executive authorities
in the province shall render such assistance to the Election Authority in the
discharge of its functions as may be required of them.
CHAPTER III‑DELIMITATION OF ELECTORAL UNITS
